Apart from holding constant dialogue with the MOH to ensure maintenance of no stock-out level for RH commodities, Eritrea has also implemented key demand generation activities at community level as a way of expanding the contraceptive method mix making broad range of methods available in more SDPs and with expanded national coverage. The establishment of successful mechanisms to coordinate inputs and

of the project. The Government stressed the importance of adopting harmonized

III. Procurement and Disbursement Arrangements
95. 
Procurement. Particular care has been given to procurement arrangements under
the program, in order to assure an immediate but transparent response to the emergency
situation. Implementation will have to be fast, efficient and transparent throughout the
program and, for that purpose, a "Manual ofprocurement procedures under ERP" has
been drafted by the Borrower in coordination with the Bank. The manual, which will be
adopted by other Participating Partners (PPs), thus allowing harmonization of
procurement procedures, incorporates a wide range of procurement methods which will
be used for the procurement of commodities, goods, works and consulting services.
Under ERP, most of the procurement methods will not be subject to specific monetary

5.2.5 The Accounting Department of the MOE will be responsible for financial control and internal auditing of the project. The accounts personnel to be involved in the project will be given training, as appropriate, in Bank procedures. External auditors will audit the project annually.

5.2.6 To ensure maximum transparency and to provide the PMUs with clear guidelines on policies, rules and procedures to be followed, a Project Implementation Document has been prepared. In addition, a Project Operations Manual will be prepared by the PMU. The Manual is based on internationally recognised best practices and will be developed with the technical support of the Bank staff. The manual will contain sections outlining legal status, institutional arrangements, target groups, management systems, relations with local authorities, procurement and financial procedures, personnel recruitment procedures, conflict of interest issues, monitoring and evaluation procedures and requirements, reporting procedures, etc. The status and structure of the Project Operation Manual shall not be changed without the prior approval of the Fund.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
